sentence: This project studies how to make polymers such as polyurethanes and polycarbonates from carbon dioxide using catalysts that contain no metal.
This project builds computational tools to simulate semiconductors that use light to generate electricity in integrated energy microgenerators.
This project studies how grasses respond to drought in the soil and the atmosphere, from single cells up to whole grasslands.
This project links bat research networks around the world to study bat ecology, evolution and how bats respond to changing environments.
This project studies whether short, high-current electrical pulses can stabilize gallium nitride electronics that suffer from defects in extreme environments.
This project develops a manufacturing method for optical encoders, which are sensors that measure position, using projection lithography.
This project builds a system that decides which type of memory should hold new data when it is first created, so computers run faster.
This project studies how sensing wing bending helps insects keep steady flight, using flight behavior tests and recordings from neurons.
This project builds methods that help machines detect and interpret euphemisms, which are mild phrases used in place of harsher ones, in different languages.
This project develops artificial intelligence methods to predict what proteins do, especially proteins that are understudied.
This project studies how climate change will affect precipitation, snow and runoff in a river basin, using cloud computing.
This project builds an open data system with quality checks for crowdsourced geospatial accessibility data that combines human judgments and artificial intelligence labels.
This project tests whether a shared support service for cybersecurity and data management can help smaller research institutions do research.
This project builds a framework that describes how different visual recognition tasks relate to each other and how deep networks can be reused.
This project computes the gravitational wave signals that colliding black holes should produce, so detectors can better read the information the waves carry.
This project designs a desktop system that spins fibers from biomaterials so that smart textiles can be made more sustainably.
